comments.text:
Got the Citrus Neo / 512Gb.I been on this thing all day everyday since getting it. As a Windows user my whole life, and I will continue to be, not so much "switching" as supplimenting my platforms, goes very nice with my iPad mini 5 I am quickly learning as well. I will add, my dear wife bought it for me after noticing I was watching so many Neo unboxing and review videos.

So far even with a mere 8Gb of unexpandable ram and the iPhone processor all the basic stuff, browsing multiple tabs, watching youtube etc, it feels just as snappy as my 15 inch Asus Laptop with Windows and 16Gb ram, I suspect though if the Windows laptop had only 16Gb it would not feel as snappy. I am very quckly adapting to the differences between Windows/MacOS and already have adjusted many settings to work better with the way I function.

comments.text: As much as this is a really compelling machine for a lot of people, I would encourage anybody thinking about gaming to look for a good deal on an M4 or M5 MacBook Air instead.
